pixel_roles: open leaf lower free edge, not a stationary jamb

caveat: Observed decorative room and painting gallery share this visible opening; corridor opening is distinct. Provisional scale from bookcase front endpoints. Split wood points support floor orientation locally; flat floor extension, threshold levels and ray-derived clearance boxes are hypotheses. Left input is an open leaf edge, not fixed architecture. No full room extents, unseen connectors, physical collision acceptance or production integration.

visual_cloud_alignment.caveat: Cached older dense reconstruction is visual context only; it includes prior correlated training views and must not enter held-out geometry checks or physical collision acceptance.

doorway_correction.correction: wide shots put the long-gallery doorway on the wall perpendicular to the sofa; purple doorway remains opposite the sofa wall. The v15 same-wall sofa/gallery-door arrangement was wrong.
doorway_correction.confidence: wall relationships visually corroborated; metric positions remain provisional pending matched wide renders
